title: The mystery on Kamino
description: Conferring with Yoda, and after some helpful tips from old friend Dexter Jettster, Obi-Wan Kenobi solves the mystery of the saberdart used in the assassination attempt on Senator Amidala. He follows this trail to the faraway planet Kamino, where an even more startling discovery is made: an army of clones has been created for the Republic, all of them derived from the template of bounty hunter Jango Fett...the dart-shooting "rocket man" Kenobi is searching for. After a struggle, Jango appears to defeat his Jedi pursuer and takes off for the planet Geonosis, young son Boba in tow. But the Fetts are unaware that Kenobi has placed a homing beacon on their ship and is in hot pursuit...
